name: XMMSL2 J125851.2+235522
rationale: Candidate previously unreported RASS-to-eRASS1 decline of the known Seyfert 1 KUG 1256+241. The RASS, XMM, Swift and eROSITA positions support the named host. The published primary optical identification and independent extended galaxy agree. There is no competing Gaia astrometric/variable star or second eRASS1 source in the approximate bright-state 95% circle. The complete Li sample excludes this name. Later eROSITA tables cross-identify 2RXS and contain later fluxes. Two alert loci, one at 3.77 arcsec, have no attached TNS entry. These checks leave a candidate for the change, with incomplete global TNS coverage, residual ROSAT-beam ambiguity and no established physical mechanism.
